question:
How many cubes are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f2de484cab311784b4823562916ff18cb919c95e37a66013cd972bf6bc948ca.png]
solution:
The number of cubes in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of cubes = 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb9af5557d0985cc02c7eb85aae65baecb613f643bc404021037cc32479eba21.png] 

2) Number of cubes = 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1118f75cf4fcb4da32402e792b33a4e324949e5f14c69ec885d7e3e86fdd92.png] 

As marked, there are a total of (8 + 3) = 11 cubes.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
